default_value.question: How do I book a parking spot?
default_value.answer: You can reserve your parking space online by selecting your parking dates, entering your details, and completing the booking process.

default_value.question: Is the shuttle service to JFK Airport free?
default_value.answer: Yes. Our shuttle service is completely complimentary for all customers and runs 24/7 between our lot and every JFK terminal.

default_value.question: How early should I arrive at the parking facility?
default_value.answer: We recommend arriving at least 30 minutes before you need to be at the terminal. The shuttle ride takes only 5 to 7 minutes.

default_value.question: Is my car safe while I'm traveling?
default_value.answer: Absolutely. Our lot is barrier-controlled with 24/7 security monitoring, so your vehicle stays secure for the whole trip.

default_value.question: How do I get picked up after returning from JFK?
default_value.answer: Simply call us once you have collected your luggage and our shuttle will meet you at the terminal pickup area within minutes.
